company: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
title: Research Assistant
description: Nested Halftone QR Codes, supervised by Dr. Hoover Yin
highlights: Nested Halftone QR Codes embed multiple layers of QR information within a visually meaningful halftone image, allowing the same code to carry more data while remaining more aesthetically integrated with graphics.
Investigated the effects of placement and colour contrast on nested halftone QR codes to achieve higher information density while maintaining scan reliability.
Developed a nested halftone QR code generator in Kotlin/JVM, enabling experiments with varied sizes, colours, positions of the nested QR code and error correction levels.
